heroTitle: Expanding the already substantial 43-101 gold resources of a past-producing <mark>mine</mark>
heroDescription: TSX-V: GGM · OTC PK: GBBFF · Frankfurt: B6DA
welcomeDescription:
Granada Gold Mine Inc. is a Canadian junior mining and exploration company. The Company's current focus is directed towards the development and continued exploration of the past-producing Granada Gold Property situated in the heart of the famous Abitibi Greenstone Belt and along the prolific "Cadillac Trend" where more than 50 million ounces of gold have been mined in the last 100 years.

This potential near-surface and underground Gold deposit is located 15 minutes from Rouyn-Noranda Quebec. The Rouyn-Noranda airport offers easy access into the area on paved roads to the mine site. The area offers excellent infrastructure and good supply of skilled labour throughout the region.
locationDescription: Granada Gold Mine (TSX.V: GGM) continues to advance the past-producing Granada Gold Property near Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec, with the goal of continued exploration and increasing the already substantial NI-43-101 resources. This mesothermal, structurally controlled vein deposit rests in the heart of the prolific Cadillac Trend where over 50 million ounces of gold have been produced historically between Rouyn-Noranda and Val d'Or.
